Expo SDK 54 with Continuous Native Generation: android/ and ios/ come from expo prebuild, are never committed, and drift is fixed by --clean
Multi-document blueprint, one runs-on linux and one runs-on macos document with a snapshot each; a snapshot mismatch is fixed there
kade-haptics is a Swift Expo module with a JS fallback: native on iOS, a harmless no-op on Android
Xcode version selected explicitly with DEVELOPER_DIR on the macOS machine
What was not exercised: haptic feel on a physical iPhone, store signing and EAS, live API mode
